licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). The German singing translation is left out. Bars 1–13 are secco recitative; from bar 14 the last lines are set with orchestra, Allegro moderato. Playback tempo: Free, as recitative is sung: played here at a speaking pace, ♩ = 100, kept for the closing Allegro moderato too, from the median length of five recordings (Böhm, Haitink, Solti, Nézet-Séguin, Currentzis; about 1 minute).
